description: Pattern rules for a Spring Boot or Java upgrade. Rules are data: add a rule here, not in a script. Fields: id, title, severity (high, medium, low, info), source (diff-added, diff-removed, diff-any, inventory, inventory-findings, dependency, dependency-analyze, api, library-api, it-not-run), fileGlob (optional), pattern (regex, for diff sources), field or types (inventory sources), match (dependency, api and library-api sources), scope (global = every flow, symbol = flows that reach the symbol, test = tests only, none = no flow impact), impact, check.

rules.title: Java release or runtime level changed
rules.impact: The bytecode level and the JDK that runs the app change. JDK-dependent behavior (string and time APIs, TLS defaults, reflection) can change.
rules.check: Run the startup smoke check and the probes on the target JDK (phase 5).

rules.title: Starter removed from the build
rules.impact: The web starter is replaced. Auto-configuration and MVC defaults can change for every endpoint.
rules.check: Probes on every endpoint, and the bean and property dump diff (phase 5).

rules.title: Coverage tool version changed
rules.impact: Coverage numbers and the coverage gate can change. The gate result is part of the build result in phase 1.
rules.check: Phase 1 build passed on both sides with the coverage gate enabled.

rules.title: Jackson package changed (Jackson 2 to 3)
rules.impact: Jackson 3 moves the ObjectMapper package and changes some JSON defaults. Request and response bodies on every endpoint can change.
rules.check: Probes on JSON request and response bodies (phase 5).

rules.title: Test support annotation or package moved
rules.impact: The test does not compile or runs with a different configuration after the upgrade. The test result is then not evidence for the new version.
rules.check: The test runs and passes on both sides (phase 5).

rules.title: Bean validation code changed in main code
rules.impact: Validation constraints or error mapping can change, so invalid requests can be accepted or rejected differently.
rules.check: Probes with invalid input on each request body (phase 5).

rules.title: Request mapping or content type changed in main code
rules.impact: Paths, verbs, status codes or content negotiation can change for the mapped endpoint.
rules.check: Probes on the mapped endpoint, including the content type and status code (phase 5).

rules.title: Annotation changed on a main-code declaration
rules.impact: An annotation was added or removed. Its runtime effect is the framework's, so it changes behavior without a change to the method body.
rules.check: Probes on the flows that reach the declaration (phase 5).

rules.title: Signature changed on a main-code declaration
rules.impact: The method or type signature changed. Callers and reflection-based frameworks see a different contract.
rules.check: Callers in the reach of the symbol are tested (phase 4 reach and phase 5 probes).

rules.title: Field default changed in main code
rules.impact: A field default changed, so behavior is different when the value is not set explicitly.
rules.check: Probes that rely on the default (phase 5).

rules.title: Branch or catch block removed in main code
rules.impact: A condition or error path is gone. Inputs that took that path now take a different one.
rules.check: A test or probe that takes the removed path (phase 5).

rules.title: Test assertion weakened, test removed or disabled
rules.impact: The test no longer proves what it proved on master. A pass is then not evidence.
rules.check: A reviewer confirms the assertion change is intended (phase 7).

rules.title: Integration test class is not run by the build
rules.impact: Classes named *IT are excluded from the default test run and no failsafe plugin runs them. Their result is not in the build result.
rules.check: Set build.integrationTests to auto in the config (stage 1 then runs them through surefire), or add the failsafe plugin.

rules.title: Library class or member used by master code is removed or moved
rules.impact: Master code called a library API that change_branch's library version no longer has. change_branch code was migrated to a replacement, whose behavior can differ.
rules.check: Validate the replacement against the library's release notes (release-notes agent), and run the probes and tests of the flows that reach the code (phase 5).

rules.title: Library class used by change_branch code has a changed public API
rules.impact: The library class changed between the versions. The members the code calls still exist, but behavior behind them can change.
rules.check: Release notes for the class, and the probes of the flows that reach the code (phase 5).

rules.title: Actuator endpoint exposure changed
rules.impact: Management endpoints that are exposed or hidden change. Operations tooling can break.
rules.check: Probes on the actuator paths on both sides (phase 5).

rules.title: Public class or method removed
rules.impact: A public member that other code may call is gone.
rules.check: Callers in the reach of the symbol are tested (phase 5).

rules.title: Public class or method added
rules.impact: A new public member. It does not change existing behavior.
rules.check: None needed beyond review.

rules.title: Direct dependency changed by a major version
rules.impact: A major version change in a direct dependency can remove APIs and change defaults for every flow.
rules.check: Probes on every endpoint and the dump diff (phase 5).

rules.title: Transitive dependency changed by a major version (BOM-driven)
rules.impact: The BOM or a parent upgrades a library the app does not declare itself. The change still reaches the app.
rules.check: Probes on every endpoint and the dump diff (phase 5).

rules.title: Direct dependency added
rules.impact: A new direct dependency. It has no effect unless code uses it.
rules.check: Dependency analysis shows whether code uses it (phase 3).

rules.title: Code uses a library that is not declared (new in change_branch)
rules.impact: The code depends on a transitive library. A BOM or parent change can remove it without any change in the app's own pom.
rules.check: Declare the library or accept the risk; the probes cover the code that uses it (phase 5).

rules.title: Declared dependency is not used (new in change_branch)
rules.impact: A declared dependency has no use in compiled code. It can be removed, or it is used only at runtime through configuration.
rules.check: Review in phase 7.

rules.title: Direct dependency removed
rules.impact: A direct dependency is gone. Code that used it may fail at runtime, or may now use a different class.
rules.check: Probes on every endpoint, and a build with the dependency analysis (phase 3).
